svg.title: Fine-tuning Wan on discrete subgoal images
svg.desc: A current observation and sparse subgoal targets are packed by repeating each target four times. A frozen causal 3D VAE maps 1 plus 4N images to N plus 1 aligned latent slots. A clean observation or accepted subgoal prefix conditions the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B DiT, while noise is added to remaining targets. Only LoRA adapters are trained, using a masked flow-matching loss on future slots. The text encoder and VAE stay frozen.
